properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities (user's 2026-07-23 call, applied again 2026-07-24). The check to write when this is built, because the obvious one is too weak: asserting that the view returns SOMETHING ranked proves nothing. The test must assert the ranking RULE — construct a graph with a proposed Decision that governs an otherwise-ready piece of work, and require the view to surface the decision above that work, not beside it or beneath it. A second case should assert the view stays honest about its own blind spots: until cap:derived-completion lands it cannot distinguish allocated from delivered, so it must say so rather than presenting a confident ordering built on an unanswerable question. A prioritisation view that hides what it cannot see is worse than no view, because it reads as authoritative.
